title: 第7章 持孤王诏令收服四海龙族第8章 天庭怎么又震了
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第7章持孤王诏令，收服四海龙族！“山河社稷图？女娲，你这是要跟我西方教翻脸？”
看到女娲要收走西方唯一的灵脉，接引和准提当场就炸了！
当初道祖鸿钧和魔祖罗喉一战，打碎了洪荒西方九成九的灵脉，仅剩灵山这一条灵脉。
若是在让女娲收走灵山，今后西方何谈大兴？
假如真的忽悠到了三千诸佛，你让人家去哪里修炼？！
所以他们才会急眼！
哪知道，
听到二圣的质问后，女娲面如寒霜地说道：“翻脸？你们算计本圣的时候，就该知道会有今天！”
哗啦啦……
随着女娲的呵斥，山河社稷图带着无匹神威，将灵山笼罩在内！
“女娲，休得胡说！”
准提见状大怒，见到接引出手定住灵山，随手一挥，一道七彩神光挡住了山河社稷图。
与此同时，
女娲念头一动，之前砸塌西方教大殿的红袖球忽然出现，狠狠地砸在准提的后背上。
“哎呀！”
准提惨叫一声，直接被女娲砸了个趔趄，紧接着山河社稷图从天而降，直接将准提卷了进去。
一个呼吸后……
鼻青脸肿的准提从虚空中滚了下来，惨叫着砸在地上，
而女娲在教训了准提一番后，女娲气得愤然离去，
毕竟圣人不死不灭，最多也就暴打准提一顿，削了他的面子而已，杀是杀不死的！

准提的气撒完了，可帝辛那边的还没结束，
回到娲皇宫的女娲，却是越想越气！
帝辛身为人族，竟然敢亵渎身为圣人的自己，而且还仗着自己人皇的身份，斩断自己和人族的因果。
不管是不是事出有因，这口恶气是绝对不能吃的！
想到这里，
女娲马上催动招妖番，招来轩辕坟三妖——
“三妖听吾密旨：成汤国运暗淡，人皇无德，当失天下；不久后凤鸣岐山，西周生圣主，此乃天意。你三妖可隐其妖形，入朝歌引诱人皇，暗助武王伐纣，不可残害众生。事成之后，你三妖皆成正果！”
轩辕坟三妖听后大喜道：“小妖遵旨！”
……
与此同时，
洪荒已经过去了半个月，
正在上朝的帝辛，全然不知自己依然被女娲给恨上了，此时的他，正听着大臣们的奏章。
这半个月，他们借助帝辛被人道认可的事件，终于平息了‘人皇无德、亵渎圣母’的负面影响。
这时，
比干走上前来，一脸恭敬道：“大王，闻太师听闻半月前朝歌异象，特发来奏折恭贺大王，同时也将北海战事详细道来！”
看着面前记录北海战事的十几个竹简，帝辛感觉脑壳嗡嗡直响。
这闻太师是想累死自己吗？
哎，
这个世界还有待改革啊！
叹了一口气，帝辛示意下人将贴着密封的‘奏折’抬到比干面前，沉声道：“念！”

“大王，北海战事乃是机密，实在不宜当众宣读！”
还不等比干表态，一旁的商容先开口了，其他大臣也都垂下头，一副‘我不想听’样子。
content_en:
Chapter 7: With the edict of King Gu, conquer the Dragon Clan from all over the world! "Mountains and Rivers Sheji Map? Nuwa, are you trying to fall out with my Western religion?"
Seeing that Nuwa was going to take away the only spiritual vein in the West, Jie Yin and Zhunti exploded on the spot!
The battle between Dao Ancestor Hongjun and Demon Ancestor Luo Hou shattered 99% of the spiritual veins in the ancient west, leaving only the spiritual vein of Lingshan.
If Nuwa is allowed to take away Lingshan, how can the West talk about great prosperity in the future?
If you really deceive three thousand Buddhas, where would you let people go to practice? !
That's why they are anxious!
Who knows?
After hearing the Second Saint's question, Nuwa said with a frosty face: "Falling out? When you plotted against this Saint, you should have known that today would happen!"
Wow…
Following Nuwa's scolding, the Mountains and Rivers Sheji Map enveloped Lingshan with unparalleled power!
"Nuwa, don't talk nonsense!"
Zhunti was furious when he saw this. When he saw Jieyin taking action to immobilize Lingshan, he waved his hand, and a colorful divine light blocked the map of mountains, rivers and the country.
At the same time,
As Nuwa thought, the red-sleeved ball that had previously destroyed the Western Sect's main hall suddenly appeared and hit Zhunti hard on the back.
"Ouch!"
Zhunti screamed and staggered as he was hit by Nuwa. Immediately afterwards, the map of mountains and rivers fell from the sky, directly sucking Zhunti into it.
After one breath...
Zhunti, with a bruised nose and swollen face, rolled down from the void, screamed and fell to the ground,
After Nuwa taught Zhunti a lesson, Nuwa was so angry that she left angrily.
After all, a saint is immortal, so the most you can do is beat him up and give him a slap in the face, and you can't kill him!
Zhunti's anger was over, but Di Xin's was not over yet.
Nuwa, who returned to the Wa Palace, became more and more angry!
As a human race, Di Xin dared to blaspheme himself as a saint, and he also relied on his status as a human emperor to cut off the cause and effect between himself and the human race.
Regardless of whether there is a reason or not, this bad breath is absolutely not allowed to be eaten!
Thinking of this,
Nuwa immediately mobilized the demon summoning team and summoned the three demons from Xuanyuan Tomb——
"The three demons listened to my secret decree: the fate of Chengtang is bleak, the human emperor has no virtue, and will lose the world; soon the phoenix will ring in Qishan, and the Holy Lord will be born in the Western Zhou Dynasty. This is God's will. You three demons can hide their demonic forms, enter the court songs to seduce the human emperor, secretly assist King Wu in defeating Zhou, and do not harm all living beings. After this is accomplished, you three demons will all achieve positive results!"
After hearing this, the three demons of Xuanyuan Tomb were overjoyed and said: "Little demon obeys the order!"
…
At the same time,
Half a month of prehistoric times has passed,
Emperor Xin, who was going to court, had no idea that he was still hated by Nuwa. At this time, he was listening to the memorials of the ministers.
In the past half month, they had used the incident of Di Xin being recognized by humanity to finally calm down the negative impact of "the human emperor has no virtue and blasphemed the Holy Mother".
At this time,
Bigan stepped forward and said respectfully: "Your Majesty, I heard that the Grand Master heard about the vision of Chaoge half a month ago and sent a memorial to congratulate your Majesty. At the same time, he also detailed the battle in Beihai!"
Looking at the dozen bamboo slips in front of him that recorded the Beihai War, Di Xin felt his head buzzing.
Does Master Wen want to exhaust himself to death?
Hey,
This world still needs reform!
With a sigh, Di Xin motioned to his servants to lift the sealed 'memorial' in front of Bigan, and said in a deep voice: "Read it!"
"Your Majesty, the war in Beihai is a secret and it is really inappropriate to read it out in public!"
Before Bigan could express his position, Shang Rong spoke first, and the other ministers also lowered their heads, looking like "I don't want to hear it."
